title: Juniper: Networking the AI Data Center
venue_full: International Conference on Transparent Optical Networks

problem_statement.en: AI training workloads suffer from network-induced bottlenecks, specifically leaf-to-spine and spine-to-leaf congestion caused by elephant flows and incast, which lead to increased job completion times and reduced GPU utilization.
problem_statement.zh: AI 訓練工作負載面臨網路誘發的效能瓶頸，尤其是 elephant flows 與 incast 引起的 leaf-to-spine 與 spine-to-leaf 壅塞，進而延長作業完成時間並降低 GPU 利用率。

key_innovation.en: An open, standards-based Ethernet fabric design utilizing RoCEv2, combined with intent-based automation via Juniper Apstra and high-radix spine switches (PTX10000) to enable scalable, lossless, and rail-optimized AI back-end networks.
key_innovation.zh: 採用 RoCEv2 的開放標準 Ethernet fabric 設計，結合 Juniper Apstra 的意圖驅動自動化與高 radix spine 交換機（PTX10000），構建可擴展、無損且 rail-optimized 的 AI 後端網路。

key_improvements.en: 320% typical ROI in data center deployments via Apstra automation, support for 18,000+ GPUs in a 2-layer Clos fabric, and migration path to 800GbE/1.6TbE.
key_improvements.zh: 透過 Apstra 自動化，資料中心部署的典型 ROI 達 320%；2 層 Clos fabric 可支援 18,000+ GPU；並提供向 800GbE/1.6TbE 的遷移路徑。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, AI Inference
network_hw: PTX10000, QFX5200, QFX5230, QFX5240, Juniper Express Silicon, Broadcom Tomahawk ASICs
